galaxy-s24-ph.label: Samsung Galaxy S24 (base model, Philippines, Exynos 2400)

snippets.text: 6.1-inch (diagonal) all-screen OLED display, 2556-by-1179-pixel resolution at 460 ppi; 2000 nits peak brightness (outdoor).
Rear cameras: 48MP Main (f/1.6 aperture) and 12MP Ultra Wide (f/2.4 aperture).
Video playback up to 20 hours. USB-C connector with USB 2 (up to 480Mb/s). MagSafe and Qi2 wireless charging up to 15W.
Rated IP68 (maximum depth of 6 meters up to 30 minutes) under IEC standard 60529.
6.2-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display, FHD+ (2340 x 1080), 120Hz refresh rate.
Rear cameras: 50MP main (f/1.8), 12MP ultra-wide (f/2.2) and 10MP telephoto (f/2.4).
4000mAh battery; up to 29 hours video playback.
